cv.name: Gráinne Gallagher
cv.headline: Project Manager – Medical Device New Product Introduction
cv.summary: Biomedical engineer with five years in Galway medtech, moving from project coordination to running NPI projects for catheter components. Organised, calm under change control, and fluent in design control language.

experience.title: Project Manager, NPI
bullets: Manage three NPI projects from design transfer to validation with teams of 8–12
Maintain schedules in MS Project and run weekly cross-functional reviews
Coordinated IQ/OQ/PQ for a new extrusion line delivered within budget
Report status and risks to the site leadership monthly

experience.title: Project Coordinator
bullets: Tracked design history file deliverables and change orders in Agile PLM

education.details: Final year project: fatigue testing of nitinol stents
